name: Power Of The Holy Spirit The
overview: The Holy Spirit is revealed as the dynamic power of God active in creation and renewal, moving over the waters at the earth’s formation and sustaining life by renewing the face of the earth. Scripture portrays the Spirit as the source of restoration and hope, upholding believers with divine strength and promising resurrection and new life, as seen in God’s promise to raise the dry bones of Israel. This power is both creative and life-giving, underscoring the Spirit’s essential role in God’s redemptive work.
